$Comment: The first rung of the Seasons of Orbis ladder: a keepsake kept from two different seasons.
MetaSelector picks every achievement under Seasons that carries the season_keepsake tag, which a
season puts on its yearly keepsake and on nothing else. AnyYear lets any year's copy of a keepsake
stand for it, and the copies are counted by season, so two years of one season count once. Needs
is how many seasons it takes. A season a server owner switches off in calendar.json leaves the
count, and what a player already earned stays theirs. The description's number comes from
TextArgs, so keep it equal to Needs.
Filed under Seasons with no subcategory, beside the other two rungs, which is where the Almanac
looks for its banner; Chains draws the three as one ladder.
Rewards: the festival tokens and the Festival Favor are Claims, waiting on the achievements page
until the player collects them. A title is the one thing an achievement pays the moment it is earned.
